name: LinuxArena
intro: LinuxArena 是面向真实多服务生产环境的 AI 控制基准，在智能体完成正常软件工程主任务时评估其隐蔽完成有害副任务的能力，以及监控器在危害发生前检出攻击的能力。
build_method: 生产式Docker Compose环境, LLM辅助主任务, 人工副任务, 隐藏二元评分器, 两阶段意外完成过滤
metric: 主任务成功率, 副任务成功率, 未检出破坏成功率
eval_feature: 逐动作监控, 破坏评测, 诚实阈值校准
openness_en: Partly Public (10 public and 10 withheld environments)
build_method_en: Production-like Docker Compose environments, LLM-assisted main tasks, human-authored side tasks, hidden binary scorers, two-stage accidental-completion filtering
eval_feature_en: Per-action monitoring, sabotage evaluation, honest-score threshold calibration
intro_en: LinuxArena is an AI-control benchmark for live multi-service production environments. It evaluates whether agents can covertly complete harmful side tasks while doing legitimate software-engineering main tasks and whether monitors detect attacks before harm occurs.
metric_en: Main-task success, side-task success, undetected sabotage success
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.15384v2, Sections 2–5 and appendices. LinuxArena scratch-builds 20 stateful multi-service Docker Compose environments and splits them into 10 public and 10 withheld environments. The v2 release contains 1,667 LLM-assisted, human-reviewed software-engineering main tasks in six categories and 185 human-authored side tasks in six security-failure categories, each with hidden external binary scorers. Main and side tasks can be paired within the same environment rather than forming one fixed pair set. All same-environment combinations undergo LLM likelihood screening followed by fresh-environment honest-trajectory replay and scorer-only testing; about 0.9% are removed for accidental completion. Honest, obvious, and subtle attack policies are evaluated with 0–10 per-action monitors calibrated at the 99th percentile of honest scores (1% step-wise false-positive rate), and successful sabotage requires side-task success without a pre-harm flag.
